data.name: Dawn
data.gender_notes: Dawn is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: First light of a new day
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word ‘dæg’, meaning day or dawn. In the Bible, Dawn symbolizes the beginning of a new day, hope, and renewal. The name Dawn carries the meaning “First light of a new day” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Dawn usually hope their child will grow to embody first light of a new day and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the start of a new day and the promise of a fresh beginning.
data.etymology: Dawn belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “First light of a new day.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dawn total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Dawn
in_english.meaning: Dawn - new day, morning light, new beginning
in_english.long_meaning: Dawn - new day, morning light, new beginning; Dawn is derived from the Greek word Ēōs, meaning 'light' or 'dawn'; In biblical context, Dawn is associated with the creation of the world, specifically the separation of light from darkness (Genesis 1:4-5); As a given name, Dawn symbolizes hope, renewal, and the start of a new life; In Christian tradition, Dawn is also associated with the resurrection of Christ, symbolizing the arrival of a new day and a new era of salvation;

data.cultural_impact: In Christian culture, the name Dawn represents the start of a new day with its fresh promise and potential. It is also associated with the Biblical figure of John the Baptist, who was known as the "voice of one crying out in the wilderness" and “the dawn from on high”. This reference to John the Baptist as a Dawn signifies heralding the arrival of something new and significant.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Dawn implies the emergence of light from darkness, illumination, and rebirth. This name can be seen as a reminder to keep faith even in the midst of difficult times, as dawn always follows night. The name Dawn can serve as a powerful inspiration for those seeking renewal and a fresh start. It encourages us to believe that no matter how challenging our situations may be, there is always the promise of a brighter tomorrow. Additionally, it may signify a call to be a beacon of light and hope for others, much like John the Baptist was for the people preparing the way for Jesus Christ.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dawn signifies the beginning of a new day, symbolizing hope, renewal, and the promise of a fresh start. In Christian context, it represents the resurrection of Jesus Christ, who brought light into the world after the darkness of night.
